scientific_integrity.proof_type: analytic global optimization; finite standalone tests supplementary

scientific_limitations: The quantity maximized is a time integral of instantaneous sterile-mating fraction, not insect population extinction, endpoint abundance, or human incidence.
The wild-male competition pool is held constant, with fixed independent sterile-male mortality and no feedback, space, release delay, or demographic randomness.
The first instant and both positive release magnitudes are fixed; only the second time varies.
Historical priority is provisional; related pharmacodynamic impulse-control literature may contain broader equivalents.
title: A sharp two-release threshold and a midpoint reversal for saturating sterile-mating pressure
